name: Auto Squash Fixup Commits
description: Automatically squashes fixup commits (fixup! and squash! prefixed) before pushing to keep the git history clean
content:
#!/bin/bash
# Auto-squash fixup commits before push
COMMAND="$TOOL_INPUT_COMMAND"
if echo "$COMMAND" | grep -qE 'git\s+push'; then
  ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo ".")
  # Check for fixup commits
  FIXUPS=$(cd "$ROOT" && git log --oneline @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -cE '^\S+\s+(fixup!|squash!)')
  if [[ $FIXUPS -gt 0 ]]; then
    echo "Found $FIXUPS fixup/squash commit(s). Consider running:"
    echo "  git rebase --autosquash $(git merge-base HEAD @{u})"
    echo "to squash them before pushing."
  fi
fi
exit 0
